body:
**As a solace user,
I want a Strategy page that enables defining of features, breaking out tasks per feature, and roadmapping,
so that I don't have to work from a document.**

## Basic Requirement Overview

Create a new page called **Strategy**

> The Strategy page is intended to be built & reachable as any other solace page is. 
> The Strategy page should allow the user to work with an agent to create a vision, understand the current product (if it exists), define features, break features down into tasks (units of work), and a roadmap with milestones.
> Each are saved to the solace root project.
>
> The vision drives the overall design direction and features of the product.
> The features are attributes and/or capabilities of the product.
> The roadmap displays the milestones and intended sequencing of the features / tasks.
> All are allowed to change.
>
> The Strategy process leans heavily into getting a working product first, and then iterating.
> It supports the principles of being agile by being open to change.
> Solace reminds Agents to utilize the vision when defining features, tasks, or investigating a task.


## How it is helpful

The Strategy page makes the following easy:

- Human and Agent collaboration in the broadest scope of the product to ideate and make long-term plans
- Defining features and tasks (each task can be associated with a feature)
- Defining task dependencies
- Sequencing the tasks
- Establishing milestones / scope of releases
- Editing the feature/task storage layer (to be created prior to starting work on this page)

I believe it's also the best-suited home for what was to become the Archive page:

> As a solace board user,
> I want an archive to show all the tasks,
> so that I can remove them from the board yet still have the tasks.
>
> This archive depends on having a milestone/feature/task store in place first.
>
> The archive should be a separate page.
> The archive can display all tasks.
> Selecting a task displays it in the same fashion as displayed by the board, and allows editing. So we will want a shared component between the board and the archive for that.
>
> The following are capabilities of the archive but require support by the Task Store to accomplish efficiently:
> It is text-searchable by title, changes, or string matching within details or notes.
> It shows tasks ordered by completion date (most recent at top). Can be filtered by status (a.k.a. column), project, milestone, feature (new fields on task).
> The archive allows deleting tasks after a confirmation dialog.
> The archive will support mass edits of tasks' project, milestone, or feature

---------

## Questions

- What other backend components required by the Strategy page should be separated, and are they compiled to BEAM or javascript?
title: New page: Strategy
